items.criterion: Explain the observation within its context
items.priority_rationale: Ground the explanation before testing transfer
items.question: Does an independently reviewed contextual observation support this explanation?
items.recorded_next_research: Acquire an independently reviewed contextual observation

items.priority_rationale: The transfer criterion cannot be judged from one context
items.question: Does the explanation hold in a second context?
